hymns.text: A prorocului Tău Amos pomenire, Doamne, prăznuind, printr-însul Te rugăm, mântuieşte sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Proroc Amos; the common troparion of a prophet, with his name set in it.

english.text: As we keep the memorial of Thy prophet Amos, O Lord, through him we entreat Thee: save our souls.
